purpose: Point AgentLab at the asrelease Harmony engineering atomic-operation sources and define how the future Rust service will be published with AgentLab.

primaryHarmonyOpsRef.role: Rust/native Harmony engineering operation and runtime source authority

upperPipelineRef.role: Web2Atomic upper pipeline, OpenCode adapter, templates, workflow, and release tooling

relatedResearchRefs.role: WASM/native runtime performance research; not the default release source
Composite experience IR research; not the default release source

contentPointers.releaseRole: Rust workspace for alharmony-ops-core and future native/runtime carriers
Operation/session/semantic-receipt schema seed for alharmony-ops-core receipts
Generated host capability declarations for Rust/ArkTS/TypeScript alignment
Maintainer guidance for native framework, operation sessions, placement, and boundaries
Upper pipeline only: TypeScript/OpenCode/templates/workflow/release; consumes Harmony atoms, does not define the base layer

layering.scope: Basic Harmony engineering primitives: environment, project, dependency, build, and artifact inspection.
Local target execution after project/build atoms are stable.
Packaging, signing, AGC planning, and physical-device flows behind explicit authority gates.
Web2Atomic pipeline consumes Harmony atoms for Web-to-Harmony generation and validation. It must not hide or replace the base project/build layer.

publishPolicy.defaultPackaging: small Rust CLI/service payload plus manifest; do not bake into AgentLab runtime image
forbiddenContents: certificates/profiles unless explicitly public test fixtures
publishPolicy.activationRule: Do not add executable alharmony assets to aloffline until the Rust service or CLI has a built artifact with bytes, SHA256, smoke evidence, and a non-destructive install-plan/readiness check.
